fault_injections_and_boundaries.interpretation: Normalization/helper errors are outside SDK-call generic error wrapping. Normal SDK DataFrame.to_dict has no credential inputs; no actual credential leak was established.

manual_review.result: Canonical nonempty scope before client init; only selected rows require valid DiscDate; fetch rejects selected wrong-day rows before ingest.

Shared JSON helper preserves SDK-returned JSON-compatible values, including missing versus string/dash. Units, forecast/calendar/accounting/ordinary security legal type are not inferred. Fifth nonzero suffix filtering is the existing code convention, not an issuer/security-master audit.
Client init/read exceptions suppress original error messages; no api_key/cursor appears in output metadata/URL. No live auth or environment secrets inspected.
ID binds company/date reference/raw SDK row/metadata, excludes received time. Later retry retains original saved evidence and receipt; changed row gets distinct ID.
Only new explicit provider branch; companies=[] means no company refresh, provider/dataset differ from price source, quote normalizer rejects summary.

limitations: No live SDK auth/API/financial rows/current data-rights or provider coverage check. SDK contract evidence is installed implementation, not a fresh official API service test.
No production DB was read or written. Only a new memory DB and fully synthetic data were used for reimport/immutability failure checks.
Raw SDK-returned JSON representation is preserved, not original pre-SDK HTTP lexemes. SDK date coercion and111-column projection remain upstream transformations.
Injected DataFrame conversion error is recorded as an exception-wrapping boundary; it does not establish an actual credential leakage or supported SDK failure path.
No full suite run by reviewer; root will run it once after acceptance. Financial semantics/valuation/model adoption/market freshness are not certified.
